source: fixed R40 plus unchanged sealed source supplement; frozen available evidence 3/7/4
boundary: The source selector receives checked metadata with source keys, original bindings, publication-prepared units and exact costs. It receives no tool/code body. Fetch original bytes only after selection. Share immutable metadata per project snapshot and keep query weights, budget and freshness separate.
publication: Publish owner metadata, original-record geometry and immutable file headers in the same recipe transaction. Bootstrap streams one original observation at a time; subsequent exact publication deltas replace only changed owners. Remove the all-DB canonical JSON and its 32 MiB ceiling. Keep old pinned roots, read-only placement and original bytes. No manual format number.
scopePolicy: Compile the existing advisory scope parser separately on each immutable original observation at publication, grouped by file. Union these published extents only for observations admitted to the permitted query view; use an extent only when its rows are fully present. Do not parse query-selected code or rebuild a whole-file registry. This intentionally changes optional scope alternatives, so byte identity with the old subset parser is not assumed; Native authority is unchanged.
requiredChanges: streaming bootstrap and changed-owner publication without a whole-DB registry
body-free owner metadata read path and bounded shared cache
metadata-only canonical join and cost directory
prepared base range coverage, dynamic groups only at query
published scope directory with no query code parsing
reuse stable file identities for source packet keys
unchanged independent certification and final body validation
validation: native comparison with original rows, costs and bounded-record groups
missing, corrupt, foreign-scope and stale-view rejection
80 lightweight metadata consumers under shared bounds
freeze model-free outputs before reading human labels
one complete runtime diagnostic per topic after the batch, no attribute-by-attribute benchmark
stop: Do not tune weights, budget, scope parser constants or task-specific rules against frozen labels. Preserve negative results. No token or quality/adoption claim from latency or metadata checks.
